headings: What do you want to do at CSI?

links.label: Earn a Degree Build a solid academic base to start your career or transfer to university
Learn a Trade Get hands-on technical experience that prepares you for in-demand jobs
Update a Certification Keep current with continuing education and professional development
Start College Early Earn college credits while still in high school through Dual Credit
Prepare for College Complete your GED, learn English, or prepare for college
Take Classes for Fun Explore new interests and skills through short community classes
